newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates steady to up, thin activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates steady to up, thin activity.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady to higher on Monday amid continued light activity on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, this week, bid 115 percent of tariff, unchanged from July 25, similar, offer 120 percent, unchanged from July 25, similar.
- Two barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 115 percent of tariff, unchanged from July 25, similar, no offer.
- Eight barges, Illinois River, two each week of October, bid 230 percent of tariff, unchanged from July 25, similar, offer 240 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points from July 25, similar.
